rooms.title: Explore the Spaces
rooms.subtitle: A newly built detached house designed for your comfort

salotto.title: Living Room
salotto.desc: A bright living room with Smart TV, comfortable sofa, and a mini Roman bookshelf. Natural light and views of the green outdoor area create a warm, relaxing atmosphere — the perfect retreat after a day exploring the monuments.

cucina.title: Kitchen / Dining Area
cucina.desc: Fully equipped kitchen with gas stove, electric oven, microwave, moka pot, and automatic coffee machine. Dining area for peaceful breakfasts and intimate dinners — everything you need to feel at home.

camera1.title: Master Bedroom
camera1.desc: The master bedroom is designed for peaceful, comfortable rest. A premium double bed with quality linens and carefully curated details make this room the perfect retreat after a day in Rome.

camera2.title: Second Bedroom
camera2.desc: A cozy second bedroom with a one-and-a-half size bed, ideal for an extra guest or children. Welcoming and functional, with the same attention to comfort and quality as the master bedroom.

bagno.title: Bathroom
bagno.desc: Modern bathroom with shower, hairdryer, and washing machine. Well-organized space with curated finishes for everyday practical comfort, designed for stays of any length.

giardino.title: Green Outdoor Area
giardino.desc: A pleasant, quiet green outdoor space shared with the main residence, perfect for relaxing after a day in Rome. Ideal for a break in the fresh air or a reading moment.

dettagli.title: Details
dettagli.desc: The small details that make your stay unique: a framed Rome print, a mini editorial bookshelf, and Italian design touches that transform every corner into a visual experience.

esterno.title: Exterior
esterno.desc: Elegant house facade with private entrance, staircase and potted plants. A warm welcome to your private Roman hideaway.

reviews.title: What Our Guests Say
reviews.subtitle: Authentic stories from travelers who chose San Paolo Hideout

review1.name: Martina
review1.text: Abbiamo passato una notte e siamo rimasti molto soddisfatti. La casa è nuova, all'interno di una zona molto silenziosa ma vicina dell'università Roma Tre e alla metro. Non essendo di zona, bisogna fare un po' di attenzione per il percorso d'accesso, ma Nicola è stato molto disponibile e ci ha aiutato. Per il resto tutto benissimo, l'host è gentile e molto disponibile, ci ha dato la possibilità di lasciare i bagagli molto prima del checkin.

review2.name: Jose
review2.text: We had a wonderful stay here and felt comfortable from the moment we arrived. The beds were very comfortable, the sofa was amazing, and having Netflix on the TV was a great bonus after long days exploring the city. The location is excellent — so many things to do around the area, and nothing feels too far away. The private parking was a huge advantage and extremely convenient, especially in Rome where parking is nearly impossible to find. Nicola is an outstanding host — very professional, kind, and attentive. He truly went above and beyond for us.

review3.name: Riccardo
review3.text: Ottimo alloggio! Un grazie speciale a Nicola per la sua grande gentilezza, attenzione e disponibilità. Grande cura in tutti i dettagli della casa, super confortevole e immersa in un bellissimo verde. Roma è una meta frequente per me e mia figlia, sportivi e appassionati d'arte. Mille grazie per lo splendido soggiorno — arrivederci a presto!

review4.name: Diana
review4.text: Era il nostro 2° giorno a Roma. Per fortuna avevamo un parcheggio privato — fuori era impossibile parcheggiare. Buona posizione, anche a piedi è facile raggiungere tanti posti. Di sicuro torneremo a Roma e torneremo a prendere questo appartamento. Grazie

review5.name: Ili
review5.text: Wir haben einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in dem sehr netten und gut ausgestatteten Ferienhaus. Der Gastgeber hat uns sehr viel geholfen und wir kommen bestimmt bald wieder. Vielen Dank für alles, Nicola!

review6.name: Umberto
review6.text: Ottimo e accurato: davvero gentile, la struttura è impeccabile e si sta molto bene.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before your stay

q1.question: How does check-in work?
q1.answer: Check-in is available between 15:00–20:00. For special needs, guests can write to us and we'll do our best to accommodate them. Self check-in is available, but we prefer to welcome guests personally whenever possible.

q2.question: How far is the Metro station?
q2.answer: Basilica San Paolo Metro B station is a 9-minute walk away. From there you can reach the Colosseum in 4 stops, Termini in 6 stops, and EUR in 7 minutes.

q3.question: Is parking available?
q3.answer: Free parking is located right in front of the property. It's not an assigned or reservable spot, but availability is generally very high. Access is from a private street used exclusively by residents, making the area quiet and safe. Parking is free, outdoor and with no time limits.

q4.question: How do I get from the airport?
q4.answer: From Fiumicino Airport, take the regional train to Roma Ostiense (20-25 min), then 2 Metro B stops to Basilica San Paolo. Alternatively, taxi for approximately €45.

q5.question: Is it suitable for families with children?
q5.answer: Absolutely! The detached house with green outdoor area is perfect for children. We have a crib available on request. The house is spacious and safe for little ones.

q6.question: Can I work from here?
q6.answer: Of course! Fast fiber Wi-Fi, quiet environment, and a detached house. Ideal for remote work, visiting professors, or business trips to EUR.

q7.question: What is the house layout?
q7.answer: San Paolo Hideout is a newly built detached house (2025) with: living room with Smart TV and sofa, fully equipped kitchen with dining area, master bedroom with double bed, second bedroom with one-and-a-half size bed, bathroom with shower, and shared green outdoor area. Perfect for 3 guests.
